arch-2026101294-B.text: So wird dann unter durchaus edeln ' Regenten der Staat in ein Reich der Gewalttätigkeit, der Will- ‚kür verwandelt. ‘Man findet-es im Orient häufiger, daß unter edeln Mon- -archen sich durch alle Stände Verderbnis verbreitete und hierdurch Revolution entstand. So scheint es in der Dynastie Ming gewesen zu sein, die von den Mandschu gestürzt wurde.

bowls-2026101312-A.ref: The Assyrians, Babylonians, Medes and Persians
bowls-2026101312-A.label: Philosophy of History, The Assyrians, Babylonians, Medes and Persians
bowls-2026101312-A.text: When any one in Babylon fell ill, he was brought to some open place, that every passer by might have the opportunity of giving him his advice. Marriageable daughters were disposed of by auction, and the high price offered for a belle was allotted as a dowry for her plainer neighbour.

bowls-2026101312-A.label: Philosophie der Geschichte, Asien
bowls-2026101312-A.text: Das Wichtigste ist das Verhältnis des Hochlands zu den Stromebenen. Oder vielmehr ist es nicht so sehr die Hochebene selbst wie die Gebirgsschlucht beim Auslaufen der hohen Gebirge gegen die Ebene, was in welthistorischer Rücksicht ein höchst wichtiger Punkt ist.

directions-2026101300-B.label: History of Philosophy, The Philosophy of the Stoics
directions-2026101300-B.text: He often wrote over again respecting the very same thing; whatever occurred to him he put down on paper, dragging in a great variety of evidence. Thus he quoted almost entire books by other writers; and someone gave expression to the belief that if all that belonged to others were taken away from his books, only white paper would be left.

directions-2026101300-B.label: History of Philosophy, Indian Philosophy
directions-2026101300-B.text: To this the three qualities, goodness, passion, and darkness, are attributed; the further attributes of these determinations may be very interesting, but they are understood in a very superficial way.
